notes.en:
## New Features

- Add Bot-mode narrators with a dedicated chat room and the narrator composer; Bots coordinate delegated work instead of doing it directly.
- Import provider configurations from local installations during setup or when adding a provider.
- Add quote and ask-in-passing actions for selected text, and reasoning-effort and permission-mode controls to the dashboard composer.
- Group global search results by session, with excerpts, filters, pagination and navigation to the matching row; improve independent-term and two-character searches.

## Improvements

- Store and render conversation content as native blocks, use a shared provider-history projection, and move search reindexing and legacy cleanup into paced background jobs.
- Load tools dynamically for supported models while preserving cached prompt prefixes, and start tool calls as soon as their inputs are complete.
- Simplify projects to directories and sessions, automatically assigning sessions by their working directory. Retire narrative lines, chapters, the story graph, ruler, chapter review/fork/merge/split and project.db synchronization.
- Add tiered permissions for writes inside .git, on-demand Git attribution details, and copy-path/reveal actions for large files.

## Security

- Replace session JWTs with opaque, server-side session tokens; store only token hashes and enforce session validity across HTTP and WebSocket connections.

## Fixes

- Prevent subagent messages from appearing as the parent's own rows, refresh edited/restored assistant messages, and remove archived sessions from recent-tab caches.
- Preserve composer undo history and newer server drafts, repair provider deep links and default summary-model selection, and fix segmented prompt optimization.
- Improve migration handling, history restoration, CommandCode model discovery and credential caching, timeout diagnostics and degraded-read logging.
- Restore incremental-update compatibility for older clients and offer the official mirror when appropriate.

## Upgrade Notes

- Beta / prerelease channel; continues to use executor-v0.9.4 and helpers-v1.0.0.
- Database migrations are included. Before upgrading, stop active runs in chapter sessions and back up your database (~/.narrafork/narrafork.db). Legacy messages are converted to block storage by background jobs.
- Existing session JWTs are no longer accepted: sign in again after upgrading, including integrations that use a login-session token.
- Old chapter conversations remain ordinary sessions; those without a working directory prompt you to select one. Chapter metadata, review conclusions, edges and commit records are removed. Legacy chapter containers are stopped and their records removed; ports, terminal layouts and volume-snapshot application records are cleaned up. Running chapter terminals are not forcibly terminated.
- Old chapter worktree directories, Git branches and existing project.db files remain on disk and are not automatically deleted.
- Automatically created projects are public. Sessions with project visibility are readable by logged-in users who can access that project; sessions created outside the project page remain private by default. Review visibility and working directories after upgrading.
- The former Chapters & Containers settings page becomes Workspace & Containers, retaining tree snapshots and Podman setup while removing chapter-specific settings.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 Bot 模式叙述者，提供独立聊天房间与叙述者输入框；Bot 负责协调委派任务，而不是直接执行工作。
- 首次设置与添加供应商时，可从本机已有安装导入供应商配置。
- 选中文本可引用或顺便提问；首页输入框新增思考强度与权限模式选择。
- 全局搜索按会话聚合，提供摘要、筛选、分页与命中行跳转，改进多关键词独立匹配和双字符搜索。

## 改进

- 会话内容改为原生块存储与渲染，统一供应商历史投影；搜索重建与旧数据清理移至分批后台任务。
- 对支持的模型动态加载工具并保留提示词前缀缓存，工具参数完整后即可开始执行。
- 项目简化为目录与会话，按工作目录自动归属；退役叙事线、章节、故事网络图、尺子、章节评审/分叉/合并/拆分及 project.db 同步。
- .git 内部写入采用分档权限，Git 归因详情按需加载，大文件提示支持复制路径与在文件管理器中显示。

## 安全加固

- 登录会话由 JWT 改为服务端管理的不透明令牌，数据库仅保存令牌哈希，HTTP 与 WebSocket 统一校验会话有效性。

## 修复

- 修复子代理消息混入父会话自身消息行、编辑/恢复助手消息后列表未刷新，以及归档会话仍留在最近标签缓存的问题。
- 保留输入框撤销历史与较新的服务端草稿，修复供应商深链、默认摘要模型选择和多文本分段提示词优化。
- 改进数据库迁移、历史恢复、CommandCode 模型展示与凭据缓存、超时诊断及降级读取日志。
- 恢复旧版客户端增量更新兼容，并在适用时提示使用官方镜像。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，继续依赖 executor-v0.9.4 与 helpers-v1.0.0。
- 本次包含数据库迁移。升级前请停止章节会话中正在进行的运行，并备份数据库（~/.narrafork/narrafork.db）；旧消息由后台任务转换为块存储。
- 旧登录 JWT 不再有效，升级后需要重新登录；使用登录会话令牌的集成也需要更新令牌。
- 旧章节会话保留为普通会话，缺少工作目录的会提示选择目录。章节元数据、评审结论、章节边与提交记录会被删除；旧章节容器会停止并删除记录，端口、终端布局与卷快照应用记录会清理，仍在运行的章节终端不会被强制结束。
- 旧章节 worktree 目录、Git 分支及已有 project.db 文件保留在磁盘上，不会自动删除。
- 自动创建的项目为公开项目，具有项目可见性的会话可被有权访问项目的登录用户读取；从项目页之外新建的会话仍默认私有。升级后请检查会话可见性与工作目录。
- 原“章节与容器”设置页改为“工作区与容器”，保留 tree 快照与 Podman 安装入口，移除章节专属设置。
